title: Repeated spend refresh on unchanged record

provenance.limitations: The historical fault refreshed Project cost on repeated passes. This adaptation models identical watcher notices. The public holdout is a selection split.

keys.summary: Unchanged file notifications trigger a full spend recomputation.
keys.scenario: A watcher sends repeated notifications for the same transcript size and modified time.

audit: Adapted watcher reducer. It checks redundant recomputation count, not wall-clock saturation.
